t: The Department shall continue research into Gulf War illness at levels not less than those made available in fiscal year 2008, within available funds contained in this Act.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that "research" implies involving outside experts or researchers, but the text only directs a federal department to keep funding research at a set level. It names no outside party and creates no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation, or right to sue. It is a funding and program directive that stays inside the federal government.
fable.s: The Department shall continue research into Gulf War illness at levels not less than those made available in fiscal year 2008, within available funds contained in this Act.

qwen_block.w: This section mandates that a federal department (the Department of Defense or Veterans Affairs) continue internal research activities. It does not require consultation, coordination, or input from any outside parties such as the public, states, tribes, or private organizations. The action is entirely internal to the federal government.
qwen_block.s: The Department shall continue research into Gulf War illness at levels not less than those made available in fiscal year 2008, within available funds contained in this Act.
